summary: Aura Minerals Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on August 6, 2026, providing its second quarter 2026 earnings presentation. The filing details operational and financial results: Q2 production of 75 k GEO, net revenues of US$336 M, adjusted EBITDA of US$197 M, and AISC of US$1,985/GEO. It also notes net debt of US$168 M and dividend/share buybacks of US$68 M. This is a routine earnings release, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. There are no transaction terms, board recommendations, or advisors mentioned. The filing serves as a standard periodic update for investors, with no indication of a material corporate action requiring special-situations classification.
